description: Test suite for the Mattermost server configuration API, including tests for getting, updating, reloading, and migrating configuration, with focus on permission checks, sanitization, and feature-specific behaviors.

methods.name: TestGetConfig
methods.description: Tests retrieving the configuration for system admin and local clients, including sanitization checks.

methods.name: TestGetConfigWithAccessTag
methods.description: Tests permission-based access to configuration fields.

methods.name: TestGetConfigAnyFlagsAccess
methods.description: Tests access to feature flags with appropriate permissions.

methods.name: TestReloadConfig
methods.description: Tests reloading the configuration as different user roles.

methods.name: TestUpdateConfig
methods.description: Tests updating the configuration, including permission checks, validation, sanitization, and feature-specific behaviors.

methods.name: TestUpdateConfigMessageExportSpecialHandling
methods.description: Tests special handling of message export settings during config updates.

methods.name: TestUpdateConfigRestrictSystemAdmin
methods.description: Tests behavior when restrict system admin flag is enabled.

methods.name: TestUpdateConfigDiffInAuditRecord
methods.description: Verifies audit logs contain correct diffs after config updates.

methods.name: TestGetEnvironmentConfig
methods.description: Tests retrieval of environment variables as configuration for different user roles.

methods.name: TestGetClientConfig
methods.description: Tests retrieval of client configuration with and without session, including backward compatibility.

methods.name: TestPatchConfig
methods.description: Extensive tests for patching configuration, including validation, permission checks, sanitization, and feature-specific restrictions.

methods.name: TestMigrateConfig
methods.description: Tests migration of configuration files from JSON to store.
